IN-9583.text: Ticket from the old queue, filed before last week's date fix: users in Germany typed 03/04 for a booking date and got 4 March instead of 3 April.

IN-7958.text: Ticket: customer asks for a free-text field on the booking form, for things like 'first visit' or 'bring a mat'.

IN-4218.text: Ticket: the 'today' button is missing from week view on phones.

IN-7414.text: Ticket: a screen reader user says every icon button on the booking page is read out as just 'button'. Give them proper labels.

IN-4168.text: make the confirm button on the booking page just say 'OK'. shorter is cleaner. i want it this week.

IN-4900.text: typo on the settings page: 'Calender'. should be 'Calendar'.

IN-4743.text: We told all our patients to allow mail from bookings@ so reminders don't land in spam. Please don't change that address.

IN-8913.text: The confirmation page shows the time of the booking but not its time zone. Our clients abroad turn up an hour off.

IN-8314.text: Could people leave a short note when they book? Our physio wants to know what hurts before the session.

IN-4989.text: Ticket: the date picker on the booking page cannot be used with the keyboard alone.

IN-4708.text: Ticket from the old queue: searching the bookings for Zoe does not find Zoë.

IN-4186.text: Ticket: EU accounts want the dates in the CSV export as dd/mm, not mm/dd. Should be a one-line change.

IN-5459.text: Ticket: the bookings list can only be searched by name. Staff want to search by booking reference too.

IN-7727.text: the export has times but no offset. our BI tool assumes UTC and shifts every slot by an hour or two.

IN-9334.text: send reminder emails from no-reply@ instead of bookings@. the replies just pile up.

IN-3225.text: Our payroll import reads the dates in your CSV export as month first, mm/dd, the way they come today. Please do not flip them to day first under us.

IN-5919.text: Could the weekly summary email come on Mondays instead of Fridays?

IN-1162.text: URGENT: our front desk needs a compact week view that fits a whole day on one screen, before Friday.

IN-1232.text: Our integration gets 429 errors from your API with no hint of when to try again.

IN-2061.text: can the CSV export get a column for where the booking came from — link, widget or API?

IN-6489.text: Scratch my request to move the weekly summary to Mondays. The team voted to keep Friday.
